subject: Demo runway safety net — invoice in review, need short buffer
messages:
From: Sylvia Ortega <sylvia.ortega@medicaexample.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@medicaexample.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Demo runway safety net — invoice in review, need short buffer

Hi Rishi,

Quick note from procurement: our invoice for the pilot was routed to a secondary approver this morning (unexpected). Finance expects clearance in ~10–14 business days, but our clinical team needs the sandbox live this week to finish the integration proof points.

Is there any way Redwood can keep the demo environment active for an extra three weeks while the invoice cycles? We won't be able to get a PO out faster than that. If needed, I can provide a statement from Finance confirming the queue status.

We really like the latency/cost numbers from the last run and want to keep momentum. Appreciate any short-term options.

Thanks,
Sylvia Ortega
Head of Integrations — Medica Health
Sylvia.Ortega@medicaexample.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: invoice_4571.pdf (PDF, 112 KB)]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Ortega <sylvia.ortega@medicaexample.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo runway safety net — invoice in review, need short buffer

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the heads up and the invoice. Sorry to hear procurement got routed. We want to avoid the team losing momentum. Two quick options we can offer immediately:

1) Temporary token grant: a 14-day sandbox token voucher to keep the environment live while your PO clears.
2) One-time temporary extension: we can approve a 21-day extension to the current pilot window if Finance confirms the PO is in-flight (email from procure@ or a short note).

Could you confirm which option you prefer? If you want the 21-day path, CC a procurement note or forward the approval thread and we'll provision an extension and mark it in HubSpot. If you want the 14-day voucher now, I can attach the voucher and activate it before end of day.

Also looping in Camila (solutions) and Grace (CS lead) to make sure the team has access and we don't hit rate limits during the extension.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference
[Attachment: temporary-access-voucher.pdf (stub)]

From: Sylvia Ortega <sylvia.ortega@medicaexample.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@medicaexample.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo runway safety net — invoice in review, need short buffer

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the options. Finance just confirmed they'll push the approver but the earliest guaranteed clearance is 18 business days from today (internal holiday next week slows it down). Given the integration timeline, could we take the 21-day extension? I can forward the procurement acknowledgement thread as proof (attached).

If you need any sign-off form or a DocuSign to acknowledge the extension terms, let me know and I’ll get it routed. We want to avoid spinning up a parallel environment — keeping the existing sandbox active is ideal.

Forwarding finance note in a separate email.

—
Sylvia

From: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Ortega <sylvia.ortega@medicaexample.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo runway safety net — invoice in review, need short buffer

Hi Sylvia — Grace here from CS. Thanks for the procurement update and for sharing the acknowledgement. We can approve a one-time 21-day pilot extension as a courtesy to preserve your integration timeline. Next steps:

- Please reply-all with a short confirmation that the PO is in-flight and the expected clearance date (we just need the email trail).
- If your legal/procurement prefers a brief addendum, we have a one-page extension addendum we can send via DocuSign (no cost).

I’ve recorded the extension in HubSpot (DEAL-2027-042) and attached a temporary-access-voucher (activation code included). Voucher validity: 21 days starting today. If the PO clears sooner, we’ll convert usage to the committed contract once signed.

Activation details:
- Voucher code: MEDICA-EXT-21D
- Applied to existing sandbox: medica-sandbox-01

Let me know if you want the DocuSign addendum — I can send it now.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0202

[Attachment: temporary-access-voucher.pdf (PDF, 2 KB, contains code MEDICA-EXT-21D)]
